name: Mystery
gm_moves: a witness changes their story, or stops talking
the culprit acts: a clue is destroyed, a door is locked, someone is warned
a clue points somewhere new and unwelcome
the clock runs: the next victim, the ship that leaves, the evidence that rots
someone powerful asks them to stop looking
checks: a solvable case: who, how and why each have 3+ clues in 2+ places, every place reachable, solved 95% of the time with a third of the clues missed
no empty story axis, and no seed fact contradicted
